notes: All four records are workbook/spreadsheet stubs whose bodies contain only generic template headings (Key Compliance Intent, Failure Modes, etc.) and no regulation text, so the UI 'full text' label is misleading. AI summaries repeat generic template content and in two cases (Tier 3, Part 575) confuse scope with other CFR parts. Precheck had no flags for these items. Status of CARB ACC II needs a current-law caveat.
